verses.sloka: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम् ।सुग्रीवः पूजयाञ्चक्रे राघवं प्रशशंस च ॥४-११-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasya vacanaṁ śrutvā harṣapauruṣavardhanam ।sugrīvaḥ pūjayāñcakre rāghavaṁ praśaśaṁsa ca ॥4-11-1॥।।

translations.english: The words of Rama boosted Sugriva's joy and manliness. He offered him prayers and praise:
translations.hindi: किष्किन्धाकाएड का बारहवां संग पूरा हुआ | त्रयोदशः संगः —B — ऋश्यमूकात्स धर्मात्मा किष्कित्यां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । जगाम सहसुग्रीवो बालिविक्रमपालिताम्‌

verses.sloka: असंशयं प्रज्वलितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्मातिगैश्शरैः ।त्वं दहेः कुपितो लोकान्युगान्त इव भास्करः ॥४-११-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: asaṁśayaṁ prajvalitaistīkṣṇairmarmātigaiśśaraiḥ ।tvaṁ daheḥ kupito lokānyugānta iva bhāskaraḥ ॥4-11-2॥।।

translations.english: 'There is no doubt that your sharp, blazing arrows will pierce through the vital parts of the body once you are angry, just as the Sungod burns all worlds at the end of the Yuga.
translations.hindi: आऔरामचन्द्र जी ने अपने धनुष पर रोऱा चढ़ा कर ओर सूर्य की तरह चमचमाते और लड़ाई में काम आने वाले तीर, हाथ में ले लिये

verses.sloka: वालिनः पौरुषं यत्तद्यच्च वीर्यं धृतिश्च या ।तन्ममैकमनाश्श्रुत्वा विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम् ॥४-११-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: vālinaḥ pauruṣaṁ yattadyacca vīryaṁ dhṛtiśca yā ।tanmamaikamanāśśrutvā vidhatsva yadanantaram ॥4-11-3॥।।

translations.english: Listen with single-minded attention as I tell of Vali's manliness, valour and fortitude, and then do what should be done thereafter.

verses.sloka: समुद्रात्पश्चिमात्पूर्वं दक्षिणादपि चोत्तरम् ।क्रामत्यनुदिते सूर्ये वाली व्यपगतक्लमः ॥४-११-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: samudrātpaścimātpūrvaṁ dakṣiṇādapi cottaram ।krāmatyanudite sūrye vālī vyapagataklamaḥ ॥4-11-4॥।।

translations.english: 'In the early hours before Sunrise Vali crosses over the oceans from the west to the east and moving from south to north (performing sandhya) without getting fatigued.
translations.hindi: मज़बूत गदेन वाले सुगीव और महाबली लक्ष्मण, महात्मा चु « सरा: ` ७ पृष्ठतो हनुमान्‌ बीरो नलो नीलश्च वानर । तारश्चैव महातेजा हरियूदपयूथपः

verses.sloka: अग्राण्यारुह्य शैलानां शिखराणि महान्त्यपि ।ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य तरसा प्रतिगृह्णाति वीर्यवान् ॥४-११-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: agrāṇyāruhya śailānāṁ śikharāṇi mahāntyapi ।ūrdhvamutkṣipya tarasā pratigṛhṇāti vīryavān ॥4-11-5॥।।

translations.english: 'Climbing up speedily, valiant Vali would catch the huge mountain peaks.
translations.hindi: रास्ते में वे पुष्पों के बोझ मे कु इए पेड़ों को और स्वच्छ जल वाली एवं समुद्रगामिनी नदि: को खते जाते थे

verses.sloka: बहवस्सारवन्तश्च वनेषु विविधा द्रुमाः ।वालिना तरसा भग्ना बलं प्रथयताऽत्मनः ॥४-११-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: bahavassāravantaśca vaneṣu vividhā drumāḥ ।vālinā tarasā bhagnā balaṁ prathayatā'tmanaḥ ॥4-11-6॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali would break several sturdy trees in the forest with his vigour and speed, exhibiting his strength.
translations.hindi: उन लोगों फो, मुलायम हरी दूब चरने वाले और निभेय हो | वन में घूमने बाले हिरन, वहाँ की वन-स्थलियो में चारों ओर बेठे हुए देख पड़े

verses.sloka: महिषो दुन्दुभिर्नाम कैलासशिखरप्रभः ।बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयामास वीर्यवान् ॥४-११-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahiṣo dundubhirnāma kailāsaśikharaprabhaḥ ।balaṁ nāgasahasrasya dhārayāmāsa vīryavān ॥4-11-7॥।।

translations.english: 'Massive like the shining peak of mount Kailas and valiant like the mightybuffalo in form, Dundubhi possessed the strength of a thousand elephants.
translations.hindi: वे कन्दराएँ, पहाड़, घाटिया. थुराएँ, बड़े बड़े शिखर और देखने में सुन्दर दरे देखते जाते ४ ६ ैूयविमलैः पणेः पद्नेशचाका रकुड्मले; । शोभितान्‌ सजलान्‌ मागं ३7,ऋंश्च व्यलोकयन्‌

verses.sloka: वीर्योत्सेकेन दुष्टात्मा वरदानाच्च मोहितः ।जगाम सुमहाकाय स्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम् ॥४-११-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: vīryotsekena duṣṭātmā varadānācca mohitaḥ ।jagāma sumahākāya ssamudraṁ saritāṁ patim ॥4-11-8॥।।

translations.english: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.

verses.sloka: ऊर्मिमन्तमभिक्रम्य सागरं रत्नसञ्चयम् ।मह्यं युद्धं प्रयच्छेति तमुवाच महार्णवम् ॥४-११-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: ūrmimantamabhikramya sāgaraṁ ratnasañcayam ।mahyaṁ yuddhaṁ prayaccheti tamuvāca mahārṇavam ॥4-11-9॥।।

translations.english: 'Reaching the mighty ocean, he implored the sea with (high) waves and hoards of gems for a fight.

verses.sloka: ततस्समुद्रो धर्मात्मा समुत्थाय महाबलः ।अब्रवीद्वचनं राजन्नसुरं कालचोदितम् ॥४-११-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatassamudro dharmātmā samutthāya mahābalaḥ ।abravīdvacanaṁ rājannasuraṁ kālacoditam ॥4-11-10॥।।

translations.english: 'O king, then the powerful and righteous king of the ocean came out and spoke to the demon (Dundubhi) who was driven to death by fate.'

verses.sloka: समर्थो नास्मि ते दातुं युद्धं युद्धविशारद ।श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि यस्ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति ॥४-११-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: samartho nāsmi te dātuṁ yuddhaṁ yuddhaviśārada ।śrūyatāṁ cābhidhāsyāmi yaste yuddhaṁ pradāsyati ॥4-11-11॥।।

translations.english: 'You are proficient in warfare. I am not competent enough to challenge you to a duel. But I will name the one who can.
translations.hindi: तड़ागों के वैरी, सफेद दाँतों वाले, भयङ्कर रूप वाले नदियों ॥ के करारों को गिराने बाले, जंगली हाथी भी देख पडे॥१०) . |, मत्तान गिरितटोकष्टाञ्जङ्गमानिव पवतान । वारणान वारिदप्रख्यान महीरणुसमुक्षितान

verses.sloka: शैलराजो महारण्ये तपस्विशरणं परम् ।शङ्करश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः ॥४-११-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: śailarājo mahāraṇye tapasviśaraṇaṁ param ।śaṅkaraśvaśuro nāmnā himavāniti viśrutaḥ ॥4-11-12॥।।

translations.english: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.
translations.hindi: बानरों को तथा ओर भो अन्य प्रकार के वनचारी जीवों को ओर आकाशचारी अनेक पत्तियों को देखते हुए, सुग्रीव के वश बरती हो, वे सब चले जाते थे

verses.sloka: गुहाप्रस्रवणोपेतो बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः ।स समर्थस्तव प्रीतिमतुलां कर्तुमाहवे ॥४-११-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: guhāprasravaṇopeto bahukandaranirdaraḥ ।sa samarthastava prītimatulāṁ kartumāhave ॥4-11-13॥।।

translations.english: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.
translations.hindi: ज्ञिस समय वे सद बड़ी तेजी से चले जारहे थे, उस समय रामचन्द्र जी ने सघन बृत्तों वाले एक वनप्रदेश को देख, सुगीव से कहा

verses.sloka: तं भीत इति विज्ञाय समुद्रमसुरोत्तमः ।हिमवद्वनमागच्छच्छरश्चापादिव च्युतः ॥४-११-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ bhīta iti vijñāya samudramasurottamaḥ ।himavadvanamāgacchaccharaścāpādiva cyutaḥ ॥4-11-14॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.
translations.hindi: र हे भित्र ! आफारास्थ मेव की तरह यह जो वृक्ष समूह है ओर जिसके चारों ओर केले के पेड़ लगे हैं,

verses.sloka: ततस्तस्य गिरेश्श्वेता गजेन्द्रविप्रलाश्शिलाः ।चिक्षेप बहुधा भूमौ दुन्दुभिर्विननाद च ॥४-११-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatastasya gireśśvetā gajendravipralāśśilāḥ ।cikṣepa bahudhā bhūmau dundubhirvinanāda ca ॥4-11-15॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

verses.sloka: ततश्श्वेताम्बुदाकारः सौम्यः प्रीतिकराकृतिः ।हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं स्वे एव शिखरे स्थितः ॥४-११-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataśśvetāmbudākāraḥ saumyaḥ prītikarākṛtiḥ ।himavānabravīdvākyaṁ sve eva śikhare sthitaḥ ॥4-11-16॥।।

translations.english: 'Then the gentle Himavan of pleasing appearance stood in the form of a white cloud on the peak and spoke:
translations.hindi: बे वनवासी सुनि सात दिन पीछे एक दिन केवल वायुभक्षण कर लेते थे । इम प्रकार उन्होंने सात सो वर्षो तक तप किआ ओर अन्त में सातों के सातों सदेह स्वर्ग को सिघारे

verses.sloka: क्लेष्टुमर्हसि मां न त्वं दुन्दुभे धर्मवत्सल ।रणकर्मस्वकुशलस्तपस्विशरणं ह्यहम् ॥४-११-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: kleṣṭumarhasi māṁ na tvaṁ dundubhe dharmavatsala ।raṇakarmasvakuśalastapasviśaraṇaṁ hyaham ॥4-11-17॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi, it is not proper for you to trouble me, for I am devoted to righteousness. I am the resort of ascetics and not adept in warfare'.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! यह लंबा चौड़: और श्रम को हरने वाला एक आश्रम है । यह उद्यान, वन, स्वादिष्ट कन्द मूल फल ओर जल से परिपूर्ण द्वै

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गिरिराजस्य धीमतः ।उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः ॥४-११-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā girirājasya dhīmataḥ ।uvāca dundubhirvākyaṁ krodhātsaṁraktalocanaḥ ॥4-11-18॥।।

translations.english: "At these words of Himavan, the wise king of mountains, Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger replied:
translations.hindi: इसमें बड़े कठोर त्रतघारी सप्रजम नामक सात मुनि तप किआ करते थे । तपस्या करते समय वे.ऊपर को पैर और नीचे को खिर किए रहते थे और. नियम से जलशयन करते थे

verses.sloka: यदि युद्धेऽसमर्थस्त्वं मद्भयाद्वा निरुद्यमः ।समाचक्ष्व प्रदद्यान्मे योऽद्य युद्धं युयुत्सतः ॥४-११-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: yadi yuddhe'samarthastvaṁ madbhayādvā nirudyamaḥ ।samācakṣva pradadyānme yo'dya yuddhaṁ yuyutsataḥ ॥4-11-19॥।।

translations.english: 'If you are unable or unwilling to fight me out of fear, tell me who wants to challenge me to a duel.

verses.sloka: हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वाक्यविशारदः ।अनुक्तपूर्वं धर्मात्मा क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम् ॥४-११-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: himavānabravīdvākyaṁ śrutvā vākyaviśāradaḥ ।anuktapūrvaṁ dharmātmā krodhāttamasurottamam ॥4-11-20॥।।

translations.english: 'On hearing such words, which no one had spoken earlier, righteous Himavan, skilful in conversation, flew into a rage and said to Dundubhi,the best of demons:

verses.sloka: वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञश्शक्रतुल्य पराक्रमः ।अध्यास्ते वानरश्श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम् ॥४-११-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: vālī nāma mahāprājñaśśakratulya parākramaḥ ।adhyāste vānaraśśrīmān kiṣkindhāmatulaprabhām ॥4-11-21॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.

verses.sloka: स समर्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तव युद्धविशारदः ।द्वन्द्वयुद्धं महद्दातुं नमुचेरिव वासवः ॥४-११-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa samartho mahāprājñastava yuddhaviśāradaḥ ।dvandvayuddhaṁ mahaddātuṁ namuceriva vāsavaḥ ॥4-11-22॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali is profoundly wise, an expert in warfare. He is capable of challenging you to a duel like Indra to Namuchi.

verses.sloka: तं शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वं यदि युद्धमिहेच्छसि ।स हि दुर्धर्षणो नित्यं शूरस्समरकर्मणि ॥४-११-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ śīghramabhigaccha tvaṁ yadi yuddhamihecchasi ।sa hi durdharṣaṇo nityaṁ śūrassamarakarmaṇi ॥4-11-23॥।।

translations.english: 'If you wish to fight, go to him quickly.He is ever heroic and difficult to combat.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा हिमवतो वाक्यं कोधाविष्टस्स दुन्दुभिः ।जगाम तां पुरीं तस्य किष्किन्धां वालिनस्तदा ॥४-११-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā himavato vākyaṁ kodhāviṣṭassa dundubhiḥ ।jagāma tāṁ purīṁ tasya kiṣkindhāṁ vālinastadā ॥4-11-24॥।।

translations.english: 'Having heard Himavan, Dundubhi, seized with anger, went to Kishkindha, the city of Vali.

verses.sloka: धारयन्माहिषं रूपं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो भयावहः ।प्रावृषीव महामेघस्तोयपूर्णो नभस्स्थले ॥४-११-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: dhārayanmāhiṣaṁ rūpaṁ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo bhayāvahaḥ ।prāvṛṣīva mahāmeghastoyapūrṇo nabhassthale ॥4-11-25॥।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु द्वारमागम्य किष्किन्धाया महाबलः ।ननर्द कम्पयन्भूमिं दुन्दुभिर्दुन्दुभिर्यथा ॥४-११-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu dvāramāgamya kiṣkindhāyā mahābalaḥ ।nanarda kampayanbhūmiṁ dundubhirdundubhiryathā ॥4-11-26॥।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

verses.sloka: समीपस्थान्द्रुमान्भञ्जन्वसुधां दारयन्खुरैः ।विषाणेनोल्लिखन् दर्पात्तद्द्वारं द्विरदो यथा ॥४-११-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: samīpasthāndrumānbhañjanvasudhāṁ dārayankhuraiḥ ।viṣāṇenollikhan darpāttaddvāraṁ dvirado yathā ॥4-11-27॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi felled the trees nearby, rent the earth with its hoofs, scratched the entrance gate of the city as an elephant would do with its horns in arrogance.

verses.sloka: अन्तःपुरगतो वाली श्रुत्वा शब्दममर्षणः ।निष्पपात सह स्त्रीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः ॥४-११-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: antaḥpuragato vālī śrutvā śabdamamarṣaṇaḥ ।niṣpapāta saha strībhistārābhiriva candramāḥ ॥4-11-28॥।।

translations.english: 'Unable to tolerate the sound, Vali jumped out of the harem along with the women like the Moon with stars.

verses.sloka: मितं व्यक्ताक्षरपदं तमुवाचाथ दुन्दुभिम् ।हरीणामीश्वरो वाली सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् ॥४-११-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: mitaṁ vyaktākṣarapadaṁ tamuvācātha dundubhim ।harīṇāmīśvaro vālī sarveṣāṁ vanacāriṇām ॥4-11-29॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:

verses.sloka: किमर्थं नगरद्वारमिदं रुध्द्वा विनर्दसि ।दुन्दुभे विदितो मेऽसि रक्षप्राणान्महाबल ॥४-११-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṁ nagaradvāramidaṁ rudhdvā vinardasi ।dundubhe vidito me'si rakṣaprāṇānmahābala ॥4-11-30॥।।

translations.english: 'O Dundubhi why are you roaring, blocking the entrance of the city? I know you are powerful. Go and save your life.'

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्य धीमतः ।उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं रोषात्संरक्तलोचनः ॥४-११-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā vānarendrasya dhīmataḥ ।uvāca dundubhirvākyaṁ roṣātsaṁraktalocanaḥ ॥4-11-31॥।।

translations.english: 'Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger when he heard the words of Vali ,the wise king of the monkeys, said:

verses.sloka: न त्वं स्त्रीसन्निधौ वीर वचनं वक्तुमर्हसि ।मम युद्धं प्रयच्छाद्य ततो ज्ञास्यामि ते बलम् ॥४-११-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: na tvaṁ strīsannidhau vīra vacanaṁ vaktumarhasi ।mama yuddhaṁ prayacchādya tato jñāsyāmi te balam ॥4-11-32॥।।

translations.english: 'O hero speaking such words in the presence of women is not proper. Come to me for a combat and I will let you know your strength.

verses.sloka: अथवा धारयिष्यामि क्रोधमद्य निशामिमाम् ।गृह्यतामुदयस्स्वैरं कामभोगेषु वानर ॥४-११-३३॥।।
verses.transliteration: athavā dhārayiṣyāmi krodhamadya niśāmimām ।gṛhyatāmudayassvairaṁ kāmabhogeṣu vānara ॥4-11-33॥।।

translations.english: 'O monkey I will restrain my anger tonight and give you time for your indulgence in sensual pleasures till morning.

verses.sloka: दीयतां सम्प्रदानं च परिष्वज्य च वानरान् ।सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्र स्त्वं संसादय सुहृज्जनान् ॥४-११-३४॥।।
verses.transliteration: dīyatāṁ sampradānaṁ ca pariṣvajya ca vānarān ।sarvaśākhāmṛgendra stvaṁ saṁsādaya suhṛjjanān ॥4-11-34॥।।

translations.english: 'O king of monkeys, hug them and give them any gift you want. Spend the night with your dear ones.

verses.sloka: सुदृष्टां कुरु किष्किन्धां कुरुष्वात्मसमं पुरे ।क्रीडस्व च सह स्त्रीभिरहं ते दर्पनाशनः ॥४-११-३५॥।।
verses.transliteration: sudṛṣṭāṁ kuru kiṣkindhāṁ kuruṣvātmasamaṁ pure ।krīḍasva ca saha strībhirahaṁ te darpanāśanaḥ ॥4-11-35॥।।

translations.english: 'Have a good look a Kishkinda. Assign some one like you kingship. Sport freely with women and come, I shall destroy your arrogance.

verses.sloka: यो हि मत्तं प्रमत्तं वा सुप्तं वा रहितं भृशम् ।हन्यात्स भ्रूणहा लोके त्वद्विधं मदमोहितम् ॥४-११-३६॥।।
verses.transliteration: yo hi mattaṁ pramattaṁ vā suptaṁ vā rahitaṁ bhṛśam ।hanyātsa bhrūṇahā loke tvadvidhaṁ madamohitam ॥4-11-36॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever kills a person, who is drunk or is heedless or is asleep or without weapons or stupified by lust in this world, is equal to a killer of a foetus in the womb.'

verses.sloka: स प्रहस्याब्रवीन्मन्दं क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम् ।विसृज्य ताः स्त्रियस्सर्वास्ताराप्रभृतिकास्तदा ॥४-११-३७॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa prahasyābravīnmandaṁ krodhāttamasurottamam ।visṛjya tāḥ striyassarvāstārāprabhṛtikāstadā ॥4-11-37॥।।

translations.english: 'Then, Vali sent away Tara and all other women slowly and replied angrily to the foolish demon with a mischievous smile:

verses.sloka: मत्तोऽयमिति मा मंस्था यद्यभीतोऽसि संयुगे ।मदोऽयं सम्प्रहारेऽस्मिन्वीरपानं समर्थ्यताम् ॥४-११-३८॥।।
verses.transliteration: matto'yamiti mā maṁsthā yadyabhīto'si saṁyuge ।mado'yaṁ samprahāre'sminvīrapānaṁ samarthyatām ॥4-11-38॥।।

translations.english: 'Do not consider me drunken. This drink will serve as a warrior's drink in the combat. Be ready, if you are not afraid of a combat.'

verses.sloka: तमेवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धो मालामुत्क्षिप्य काञ्चनीम् ।पित्रा दत्तां महेन्द्रेण युद्धाय व्यवतिष्ठत ॥४-११-३९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tamevamuktvā saṅkṛddho mālāmutkṣipya kāñcanīm ।pitrā dattāṁ mahendreṇa yuddhāya vyavatiṣṭhata ॥4-11-39॥।।

translations.english: 'Having addressed thus in a rage, Vali removed the golden garland gifted by Indra, his father, and stood ready for the combat.

verses.sloka: विषाणयोर्गृहीत्वा तं दुन्दुभिं गिरिसन्निभम् ।आविध्यत तदा वाली विनदन्कपिकुञ्जरः ॥४-११-४०॥।।
verses.transliteration: viṣāṇayorgṛhītvā taṁ dundubhiṁ girisannibham ।āvidhyata tadā vālī vinadankapikuñjaraḥ ॥4-11-40॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali, the elephantlike monkey then held the mountainlike Dundubhi by the horns and struck him down, roaring loudly.

verses.sloka: वाली व्यापातयाञ्चक्रे ननर्द च महास्वनम् ।श्रोत्राभ्यामथ रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः ॥४-११-४१॥।।
verses.transliteration: vālī vyāpātayāñcakre nanarda ca mahāsvanam ।śrotrābhyāmatha raktaṁ tu tasya susrāva pātyataḥ ॥4-11-41॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali whirled him round and round and threw him downroaring. Blood flowed from Dundubhi's ears.

verses.sloka: तयोस्तु क्रोधसंरम्भात्परस्परजयैषिणोः ।युद्धं समभवद्घोरं दुन्दुभेर्वानरस्यच ॥४-११-४२॥।।
verses.transliteration: tayostu krodhasaṁrambhātparasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ ।yuddhaṁ samabhavadghoraṁ dundubhervānarasyaca ॥4-11-42॥।।

translations.english: 'Each one of them was highly agitated and angry trying to win over the other. A terrific fight took place between Dundubhi and Vali.

verses.sloka: अयुद्ध्यत तदा वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ।मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिश्चैव शिलाभिः पादपैस्तथा ॥४-११-४३॥।।
verses.transliteration: ayuddhyata tadā vālī śakratulyaparākramaḥ ।muṣṭibhirjānubhiścaiva śilābhiḥ pādapaistathā ॥4-11-43॥।।

translations.english: 'Then Vali who was equal to Indra in prowess fought, hitting him with fists, knees, rocks and trees.

verses.sloka: परस्परं घ्नतो स्तत्र वानरासुरयोस्तदा ।आसीदसुरो युद्धे शक्रसूनुर्व्यवर्धत ॥४-११-४४॥।।
verses.transliteration: parasparaṁ ghnato statra vānarāsurayostadā ।āsīdasuro yuddhe śakrasūnurvyavardhata ॥4-11-44॥।।

translations.english: 'Then as the monkey and demon fought pouncing on each other, the prowess of Dundubhi got diminished and that of Vali, the son of Indra, increased.

verses.sloka: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः ।तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत् ॥४-११-४५॥।।
verses.transliteration: vyāpāravīryadhairyaiśca parikṣīṇaṁ parākramaiḥ ।taṁ tu dundubhimudyamya dharaṇyāmabhyapātayat ॥4-11-45॥।।

translations.english: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

verses.sloka: युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा ।पपात च महाकायः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः ॥४-११-४६॥।।
verses.transliteration: yuddhe prāṇahare tasminniṣpiṣṭo dundubhistadā ।papāta ca mahākāyaḥ kṣitau pañcatvamāgataḥ ॥4-11-46॥।।

translations.english: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

verses.sloka: तं तोलयित्वा बाहुभ्यां गतसत्त्वमचेतनम् ।चिक्षेप बलवान्वाली वेगेनैकेन योजनम् ॥४-११-४७॥।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ tolayitvā bāhubhyāṁ gatasattvamacetanam ।cikṣepa balavānvālī vegenaikena yojanam ॥4-11-47॥।।

translations.english: 'Mighty Vali lifted on both shoulders the insensate body drained of life and hurled it speedily to a distance of a yojana.

verses.sloka: तस्य वेगप्रविद्धस्य वक्त्रात्क्षतजबिन्दवः ।प्रपेतुर्मारुतोत्क्षिप्ता मतङ्गप्याश्रमं प्रति ॥४-११-४८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vegapraviddhasya vaktrātkṣatajabindavaḥ ।prapeturmārutotkṣiptā mataṅgapyāśramaṁ prati ॥4-11-48॥।।

translations.english: 'Scattered by the wind, drops of blood fell at the hermitage of Matanga from the mouth of the deadbody flung.

verses.sloka: तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितांस्तस्य मुनिश्शोणितविप्रुषः ।क्रुद्धस्तत्र महाभागश्चिन्तयामास कोन्वयम् ॥४-११-४९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tāndṛṣṭvā patitāṁstasya muniśśoṇitavipruṣaḥ ।kruddhastatra mahābhāgaścintayāmāsa konvayam ॥4-11-49॥।।

translations.english: 'The venerable sage became furious to see drops of blood fallen there. He started thinking who could he be?

verses.sloka: येनाहं सहसा स्पृष्टश्शोणितेन दुरात्मना ।कोऽयं दुरात्मा दुर्भुदि्घरकृतात्मा च बालिशः ॥४-११-५०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yenāhaṁ sahasā spṛṣṭaśśoṇitena durātmanā ।ko'yaṁ durātmā durbhudi्gharakṛtātmā ca bāliśaḥ ॥4-11-50॥।।

translations.english: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वाऽथ विनिष्क्रम्य ददर्श मुनिसत्तमः ।महिषं पर्वताकारं गतासुं पतितं भुवि ॥४-११-५१॥।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā'tha viniṣkramya dadarśa munisattamaḥ ।mahiṣaṁ parvatākāraṁ gatāsuṁ patitaṁ bhuvi ॥4-11-51॥।।

translations.english: 'The venerable sage came out of the hermitage and saw a mountaneous buffalo fallen dead on the floor.

verses.sloka: स तु विज्ञाय तपसा वानरेण कृतं हि तत् ।उत्ससर्ज महाशापं क्षेप्तारं वालिनं प्रति ॥४-११-५२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu vijñāya tapasā vānareṇa kṛtaṁ hi tat ।utsasarja mahāśāpaṁ kṣeptāraṁ vālinaṁ prati ॥4-11-52॥।।

translations.english: 'Having known through his ascetic vision that it was the act of a monkey, he pronounced a curse on Vali who had hurled (the body):

verses.sloka: इह तेनाप्रवेष्टव्यं प्रविष्टस्य वधो भवेत् ।वनं मत्संश्रयं येन दूषितं रुधिरस्रवैः ॥४-११-५३॥।।
verses.transliteration: iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṁ praviṣṭasya vadho bhavet ।vanaṁ matsaṁśrayaṁ yena dūṣitaṁ rudhirasravaiḥ ॥4-11-53॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever has desecrated this forest, protected by me, with drops of blood is forbidden to enter this place. Once he does it, he will die.

verses.sloka: सम्भग्नाः पादपाश्चैमेक्षिपतेहासुरीं तनुम् ।समन्तादाद्योजनं पूर्णमाश्रमं मामकं यदि ॥४-११-५४॥।।
verses.transliteration: sambhagnāḥ pādapāścaimekṣipatehāsurīṁ tanum ।samantādādyojanaṁ pūrṇamāśramaṁ māmakaṁ yadi ॥4-11-54॥।।

translations.english: 'Whoever has broken the trees all over this forest and has thrown the demon's body will not survive if he enters within a radius of one yojana of my hermitage.

verses.sloka: आगमिष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्व्यक्तं स न भविष्यति ।ये चापि सचिवाः स्तस्य संश्रिता मामकं वनम् ॥४-११-५५॥।।
verses.transliteration: āgamiṣyati durbuddhirvyaktaṁ sa na bhaviṣyati ।ye cāpi sacivāḥ stasya saṁśritā māmakaṁ vanam ॥4-11-55॥।।

translations.english: 'Indeed his counsellors who are here must leave this forest. Let them depart safely.

verses.sloka: न च तैरिह वस्तव्यं श्रुत्वा यान्तु यथासुखम् ।यदि तेऽपी ह तिष्ठन्ति शपिष्ये तानपि ध्रुवम् ॥४-११-५६॥।।
verses.transliteration: na ca tairiha vastavyaṁ śrutvā yāntu yathāsukham ।yadi te'pī ha tiṣṭhanti śapiṣye tānapi dhruvam ॥4-11-56॥।।

translations.english: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

verses.sloka: वनेऽस्मिन्मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत्परिरक्षिते ।पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च ॥४-११-५७॥।।
verses.transliteration: vane'sminmāmake nityaṁ putravatparirakṣite ।patrāṅkuravināśāya phalamūlābhavāya ca ॥4-11-57॥।।

translations.english: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

verses.sloka: दिवसश्चास्य मर्यादा यं द्रष्टा श्वोऽस्मि वानरम् ।बहुवर्षसहस्राणि स वै शैलो भविष्यति ॥४-११-५८॥।।
verses.transliteration: divasaścāsya maryādā yaṁ draṣṭā śvo'smi vānaram ।bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi sa vai śailo bhaviṣyati ॥4-11-58॥।।

translations.english: 'I give one day's time for the monkeys (to leave). Whomsoever, I see tomorrow will get transformed into a mountain for many thousands of years'

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वानराश्श्रुत्वा गिरं मुनिसमीरिताम् ।निश्चक्रमुर्वनात्तस्मात्तान्दृष्ट्वा वालिरब्रवीत् ॥४-११-५९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vānarāśśrutvā giraṁ munisamīritām ।niścakramurvanāttasmāttāndṛṣṭvā vālirabravīt ॥4-11-59॥।।

translations.english: 'The monkeys fled on hearing the words spoken by the sage. Said Vali:

verses.sloka: किं भवन्तस्समस्ताश्च मतङ्गवनवासिनः ।मत्समीपमनुप्राप्ता अपि स्वस्ति वनौकसाम् ॥४-११-६०॥।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ bhavantassamastāśca mataṅgavanavāsinaḥ ।matsamīpamanuprāptā api svasti vanaukasām ॥4-11-60॥।।

translations.english: 'Why have you, residents of the groves of Matanga, come to me? Hope all are safe'

verses.sloka: ततस्ते कारणं सर्वं तदा शापं च वालिनः ।शशंसुर्वानरास्सर्वे वालिने हेममालिने ॥४-११-६१॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataste kāraṇaṁ sarvaṁ tadā śāpaṁ ca vālinaḥ ।śaśaṁsurvānarāssarve vāline hemamāline ॥4-11-61॥।।

translations.english: 'Then all the monkeys collected together and narrated everything about the curse given to Vali , adorned with a golden chain(on his neck).

verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम् ।स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः ॥४-११-६२॥।।
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā tadā vālī vacanaṁ vānareritam ।sa maharṣiṁtadā'sādya yācate sma kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥4-11-62॥।।

translations.english: 'On hearing the monkeys, Vali went to the sage and begged forgiveness with folded hands.

verses.sloka: महर्षिस्तमनादृत्य प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा ।शापधारणभीतस्तु वाली विह्वलतां गतः ॥४-११-६३॥।।
verses.transliteration: maharṣistamanādṛtya praviveśāśramaṁ tadā ।śāpadhāraṇabhītastu vālī vihvalatāṁ gataḥ ॥4-11-63॥।।

translations.english: 'The sage went into the hermitage without obliging Vali who became apprehensive of the curse of the sage.

verses.sloka: ततश्शापभयाद्भीत ऋश्यमूकं महागिरिम् ।प्रवेष्टुं नेच्छति हरिर्द्रष्टुं वापि नरेश्वर ॥४-११-६४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataśśāpabhayādbhīta ṛśyamūkaṁ mahāgirim ।praveṣṭuṁ necchati harirdraṣṭuṁ vāpi nareśvara ॥4-11-64॥।।

translations.english: 'O Lord Rama because of the fear of the curse, Vali will not enter the great Rishyamuka mountain nor will he like to see it.

verses.sloka: तस्याप्रवेशं ज्ञात्वाऽहमिदं राम महावनम् ।विचरामि सहामात्यो विषादेन विवर्जितः ॥४-११-६५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāpraveśaṁ jñātvā'hamidaṁ rāma mahāvanam ।vicarāmi sahāmātyo viṣādena vivarjitaḥ ॥4-11-65॥।।

translations.english: 'O Rama aware of the prohibition of Vali from entering the place, I roam about this great forest accompanied by my ministers without any apprehension.

verses.sloka: एषोऽस्थिनिचयस्तस्य दुन्दुभेस्सम्प्रकाशते ।वीर्योत्सेकान्निरस्तस्य गिरिकूटोपमो महान् ॥४-११-६६॥।।
verses.transliteration: eṣo'sthinicayastasya dundubhessamprakāśate ।vīryotsekānnirastasya girikūṭopamo mahān ॥4-11-66॥।।

translations.english: 'Hurled with the pride of his(Vali's) prowess is this heap of bones of Dundubhi here, which shines like a huge mountain peak.

verses.sloka: इमे च विपुलास्सालास्सप्त शाखावलम्बिनः ।यत्रैकं घटते वाली निष्पत्रयितुमोजसा ॥४-११-६७॥।।
verses.transliteration: ime ca vipulāssālāssapta śākhāvalambinaḥ ।yatraikaṁ ghaṭate vālī niṣpatrayitumojasā ॥4-11-67॥।।

translations.english: 'Look at these seven sturdy Sala trees with branches of one overlapping the other. Vali was able to remove all the leaves of one Sala tree with just one arrow.

verses.sloka: एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकीर्तितम् ।कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप ॥४-११-६८॥।।
verses.transliteration: etadasyāsamaṁ vīryaṁ mayā rāma prakīrtitam ।kathaṁ taṁ vālinaṁ hantuṁ samare śakṣyase nṛpa ॥4-11-68॥।।

translations.english: 'O Rama Vali's strength and fame related by me is unequalled. O king how is it possible for you to kill him in a combat?'

verses.sloka: तथा ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं प्रहसन् लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत् ।कस्मिन्कर्मणि निर्वृत्ते श्रद्दध्या वालिनो वधम् ॥४-११-६९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tathā bruvāṇaṁ sugrīvaṁ prahasan lakṣmaṇo'bravīt ।kasminkarmaṇi nirvṛtte śraddadhyā vālino vadham ॥4-11-69॥।।

translations.english: Smiling, Lakshmana asked Sugriva, 'By what action will you trust?. By the fulfilment of which task (by Rama) will you have faith?'

verses.sloka: तमुवाचाथ सुग्रीवस्सप्त सालानिमान्पुरा ।एवमेकैकशो वाली विव्याथाथ स चासकृत् ॥४-११-७०॥।।
verses.transliteration: tamuvācātha sugrīvassapta sālānimānpurā ।evamekaikaśo vālī vivyāthātha sa cāsakṛt ॥4-11-70॥।।

translations.english: Then Sugriva told Lakshmana that earlier Vali had split through these seven Sala trees one after the other, several times.

verses.sloka: रामोऽपिदारयेदेषां बाणेनैकेन च द्रुमम् ।वालिनं निहतं मन्ये दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम् ॥४-११-७१॥।।
verses.transliteration: rāmo'pidārayedeṣāṁ bāṇenaikena ca drumam ।vālinaṁ nihataṁ manye dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam ॥4-11-71॥।।

translations.english: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.

verses.sloka: हतस्य महिषस्यास्थि पादेनैकेन लक्ष्मण ।उद्यम्याथ प्रक्षिपेच्चेत्तरसा द्वे धनुश्शते ॥४-११-७२॥।।
verses.transliteration: hatasya mahiṣasyāsthi pādenaikena lakṣmaṇa ।udyamyātha prakṣipeccettarasā dve dhanuśśate ॥4-11-72॥।।

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana and if Rama can also lift the dead buffalo's (Dundubhi's) skeleton and hurl it to a distance of two hundred bows with one of his feet.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवो रामं रक्तान्तलोचनम् ।ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं काकुत्स्थं पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥४-११-७३॥।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu sugrīvo rāmaṁ raktāntalocanam ।dhyātvā muhūrtaṁ kākutsthaṁ punareva vaco'bravīt ॥4-11-73॥।।

translations.english: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.

verses.sloka: शूरश्च शूरघाती च प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः ।बलवान्वानरो वाली संयुगेष्वपराजितः ॥४-११-७४॥।।
verses.transliteration: śūraśca śūraghātī ca prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ ।balavānvānaro vālī saṁyugeṣvaparājitaḥ ॥4-11-74॥।।

translations.english: 'Powerful Vali is valiant and has killed brave fighters. He is wellknown for his prowess and valour. He has not faced defeat in war.

verses.sloka: दृश्यन्ते चास्य कर्माणि दुष्कराणि सुरैरपि ।यानि सञ्चिन्त्य भीतोऽहमृश्यमूकं समाश्रितः ॥४-११-७५॥।।
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante cāsya karmāṇi duṣkarāṇi surairapi ।yāni sañcintya bhīto'hamṛśyamūkaṁ samāśritaḥ ॥4-11-75॥।।

translations.english: 'Even gods cannot do what he has done. Thinking of all this and being afraid of him, I have taken refuge at Rishyamuka.

verses.sloka: तमजय्यमधृष्यं च वानरेन्द्रममर्षणम् ।विचिन्तयन्न मुञ्चामि ऋश्यमूकमहन्विमम् ॥४-११-७६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tamajayyamadhṛṣyaṁ ca vānarendramamarṣaṇam ।vicintayanna muñcāmi ṛśyamūkamahanvimam ॥4-11-76॥।।

translations.english: 'Thinking that this indignant, invincible lord of the monkeys, cannot be overpowered, I have not stepped out of Rishyamuka.

verses.sloka: उद्विग्नश्शङ्कितश्चापि विचरामि महावने ।अनुरक्तैः सहामात्यैर्हनुमत्प्रमुखैर्वरैः ॥४-११-७७॥।।
verses.transliteration: udvignaśśaṅkitaścāpi vicarāmi mahāvane ।anuraktaiḥ sahāmātyairhanumatpramukhairvaraiḥ ॥4-11-77॥।।

translations.english: Agitated and fearful, I roam this great forest together with my devoted, excellent ministers headed by Hanuman.

verses.sloka: उपलब्धं च मे श्लाघ्यं सन्मित्रं मित्रवत्सल ।त्वामहं पुरुषव्याघ्र हिमवन्तमिवाश्रितः ॥४-११-७८॥।।
verses.transliteration: upalabdhaṁ ca me ślāghyaṁ sanmitraṁ mitravatsala ।tvāmahaṁ puruṣavyāghra himavantamivāśritaḥ ॥4-11-78॥।।

translations.english: 'I have discovered in you a faithful friend. O tiger among men, O venerable one, you are to me like the Himalayas.

verses.sloka: किं तु तस्य बलज्ञोऽहं दुर्भ्रातुर्बलशालिनः ।अप्रत्यक्षं तु मे वीर्यं समरे तव राघव ॥४-११-७९॥।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ tu tasya balajño'haṁ durbhrāturbalaśālinaḥ ।apratyakṣaṁ tu me vīryaṁ samare tava rāghava ॥4-11-79॥।।

translations.english: 'What to do? I know the strength of my mighty bad brother. But so far I have not seen your power in a battle.

verses.sloka: न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये ।कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैस्तु कातर्यं जनितं मम ॥४-११-८०॥।।
verses.transliteration: na khalvahaṁ tvāṁ tulaye nāvamanye na bhīṣaye ।karmabhistasya bhīmaistu kātaryaṁ janitaṁ mama ॥4-11-80॥।।

translations.english: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.

verses.sloka: कामं राघव ते वाणी प्रमाणं धैर्यमाकृतिः ।सूचयन्ति परं तेजो भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम् ॥४-११-८१॥।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ rāghava te vāṇī pramāṇaṁ dhairyamākṛtiḥ ।sūcayanti paraṁ tejo bhasmacchannamivānalam ॥4-11-81॥।।

translations.english: 'Rama your word and your courage indicate your supreme strength which is like fire covered with ashes.'

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।स्मितपूर्वमथो रामः प्रत्युवाच हरिं प्रभुः ॥४-११-८२॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।smitapūrvamatho rāmaḥ pratyuvāca hariṁ prabhuḥ ॥4-11-82॥।।

translations.english: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:

verses.sloka: यदि न प्रत्ययोऽस्मासु विक्रमे तव वानर ।प्रत्ययं समरे श्लाघ्यमहमुत्पादयामि ते ॥४-११-८३॥।।
verses.transliteration: yadi na pratyayo'smāsu vikrame tava vānara ।pratyayaṁ samare ślāghyamahamutpādayāmi te ॥4-11-83॥।।

translations.english: 'If you have no confidence in my strength in fight, O monkey, I will create it in you so much so that you will admire it.'

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया ॥४-११-८४॥।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu sugrīvaṁ sāntvaṁ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।rāghavo dundubheḥ kāyaṁ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā ॥4-11-84॥।।

translations.english: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

verses.sloka: तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम् ।असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान् ॥४-११-८५॥।।
verses.transliteration: tolayitvā mahābāhuścikṣepa daśayojanam ।asurasya tanuṁ śuṣkaṁ pādāṅguṣṭhena vīryavān ॥4-11-85॥।।

translations.english: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत् ।लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमर्थवत् ॥४-११-८६॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṣiptaṁ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ kāyaṁ sugrīvaḥ punarabravīt ।lakṣmaṇasyāgrato rāmamidaṁ vacanamarthavat ॥4-11-86॥।।

translations.english: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:

verses.sloka: आर्द्रस्समांसः प्रत्यग्रः क्षिप्तः कायः पुरा सखे ॥४-११-८७॥।।
verses.transliteration: ārdrassamāṁsaḥ pratyagraḥ kṣiptaḥ kāyaḥ purā sakhe ॥4-11-87॥।।

translations.english: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

verses.sloka: लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव ।परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा ।क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन ॥४-११-८८॥।।
verses.transliteration: laghussamprati nirmāṁsa stṛṇabhūtaśca rāghava ।pariśrāntena mattena bhrātrā me vālinā tadā ।kṣiptamevaṁ praharṣeṇa bhavatā raghunandana ॥4-11-88॥।।

translations.english: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

verses.sloka: नात्र शक्यं बलं ज्ञातुं तव वा तस्य वाऽधिकम् ।आर्द्रं शुष्कमिति ह्येतत्सुमहद्राघवान्तरम् ॥४-११-८९॥।।
verses.transliteration: nātra śakyaṁ balaṁ jñātuṁ tava vā tasya vā'dhikam ।ārdraṁ śuṣkamiti hyetatsumahadrāghavāntaram ॥4-11-89॥।।

translations.english: 'I was unable to gauge whether your strength is more than his (Vali's) since there is a great difference between a dry body and a wet one.

verses.sloka: स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बले ।सालमेकं तु निर्भिद्या भवेद्व्यक्तिर्बलाबले ॥४-११-९०॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa eva saṁśayastāta tava tasya ca yadbale ।sālamekaṁ tu nirbhidyā bhavedvyaktirbalābale ॥4-11-90॥।।

translations.english: 'O Dear, therefore, I have my doubt about your relative strength. If you can split a sala tree with a single arrow then can your strength or weakness be demonstrated.

verses.sloka: कृत्वेदं कार्मुकं सज्यं हस्तिहस्त मिवाततम् ।आकर्णपूर्णमायम्य विसृजस्व महाशरम् ॥४-११-९१॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtvedaṁ kārmukaṁ sajyaṁ hastihasta mivātatam ।ākarṇapūrṇamāyamya visṛjasva mahāśaram ॥4-11-91॥।।

translations.english: 'Now string your bow, draw it like the trunk of an elephant up to your ear and release the great arrow.

verses.sloka: इमं हि सालं सहित स्त्वया शरो ।न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति ।अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं ।कुरुष्व राजात्मज शापितो मया ॥४-११-९२॥।।
verses.transliteration: imaṁ hi sālaṁ sahita stvayā śaro ।na saṁśayo'trāsti vidārayiṣyati ।alaṁ vimarśena mama priyaṁ dhruvaṁ ।kuruṣva rājātmaja śāpito mayā ॥4-11-92॥।।

translations.english: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.

verses.sloka: यथा हि तेजस्सु वरस्सदा रवि ।र्यथा हि शैलो हिमवान्महाद्रिषु ।यथा चतुष्पात्सु च केसरी वर ।स्तथा नरणामसि विक्रमे वरः ॥४-११-९३॥।।
verses.transliteration: yathā hi tejassu varassadā ravi ।ryathā hi śailo himavānmahādriṣu ।yathā catuṣpātsu ca kesarī vara ।stathā naraṇāmasi vikrame varaḥ ॥4-11-93॥।।

translations.english: 'Just as the Sun is the best among the brilliant, the Himalayas among the great mountains, the lion among the quadrupeds, so also you are the best among men of valour.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
